as_told.title: Watchers lust after and procreate with human women

plain: This story comes from the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text. It tells of beings called the Watchers who came down to Earth and had children with human women, and those children were giants. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings it up while talking about ancient times, quoting the line that there were giants on the earth in those days. The talk show host Joe Rogan tells it too, calling the offspring the Nephilim. Rogan reads it as a story of genetic engineering by visitors, and credits a US congresswoman, Anna Paulina Luna, with raising it. If read that way, it would mean old scriptures remember outside beings mixing with humanity.
